SEO Management

The standard SEO Management service provides ongoing Google Search Console configuration and monitoring, sitemap-related management, analysis of organic search performance, keyword opportunities and monthly performance reporting, as agreed with each customer.

SEO Management subscriptions and cancellation

Where SEO Management is purchased through our online checkout, the subscription is billed monthly in advance at the price shown at checkout. You can cancel by contacting us before your next billing date. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid monthly period; we do not make further subscription charges after that point. We may contact you to confirm the cancellation and any required handover of Search Console or website access.

Where needed, CFS may make limited technical configuration changes for sitemap management, Search Console verification or the agreed monitoring setup. These can include a verification meta tag or automatic sitemap generation where technically feasible. Material website changes require separate discussion and authorisation.

The monthly subscription does not include writing website content, creating new pages, bespoke development, redesigns or substantial technical remediation unless separately agreed. We may recommend those activities, but implementation is outside the standard service.

Google controls indexing and search results. CFS does not guarantee rankings, indexing, traffic, enquiries, leads or sales. Reports reflect the information available from Google Search Console and other agreed data sources, which may be incomplete, delayed or revised.
